name: Motherlode Co-Packing Corporate Offices
old_description: Located 30 min from the Denver International Airport, our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility is FDA/HACCP/SQF approved, and we are fully equipped for both food service and retail sizes to help you expand your brand. Our talented crew has more than 60 years of experience in food manufacturing and sales. We offer a variety of glass and plastic options for your sauce, syrup, dressing, or condiment.
about:
Motherlode Co-Packing operates from Hudson, Colorado, about 30 minutes from Denver International Airport. The company was founded in 1966 and has grown into a certified co-packing facility serving food brands nationwide. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and the original founders are not named in available sources.

The facility provides end-to-end co-packing services for sauces, syrups, dressings, condiments, and beverages. Its process covers formulation development with food scientists, bottling in glass, plastic, or pouch formats, and automation for scale-up. The plant is FDA, HACCP, and SQF approved and runs thousands of gallons per week. Specific facility size and headcount are not published.

Motherlode works with established food brands on both coasts that are poised for sales growth. Customers include sauce and condiment companies, a vegan food brand, and a restauranteur launching a sauce line. The company also connects brands with its investor network for capital raises and leverages a vendor rolodex for supply chain support.

The company emphasizes transformative relationships, integrity, and innovative processes. It was voted 2021 Colorado Food Manufacturer of the Year and holds a 99/100 food safety rating. All ingredients used are non-GMO. Motherlode differentiates itself by offering integrated capital, logistics, and value-engineering services alongside core co-packing.
